test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Select the sentences that contains no spelling errors.**

options.text: Our government has launched a relatively extensive set of reforms for aborgines in the country.
Our government has launched a relatively extensive set of reforms for aborigines in the country.
Our government has launched a relatively extensive set of reforms for aboregynes in the country.
Our government has launched a relatively extensive set of reforms for aborigynes in the country.

solution:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e., "aborigines."
